name: plash-desk
description: Plash용 라이브 바탕화면 - 맨해튼 펜트하우스 책상

scripts.demo-gif: rm -rf .cache/frames && node scripts/record-demo.mjs .cache/frames && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -framerate 10 -i .cache/frames/f%04d.png -vf "scale=800:-1:flags=lanczos,split[a][b];[a]palettegen=max_colors=192:stats_mode=diff[p];[b][p]paletteuse=dither=bayer:bayer_scale=4:diff_mode=rectangle" -loop 0 docs/demo.gif
